hints.auto: Unchanged: one model turn, the way this step has always run.
hints.direct: One routed model call, reserved and settled on the ledger.
hints.cascade: Start on a cheap model and escalate only when its answer fails the check.
hints.panel: Several models answer, a judge compares them, and the checked answer is returned.
hints.delegate: Hand the work to a bounded worker graph that proves its result in a sandbox. Needs a workspace.

hints.patch_only: The verified change comes back as a patch; your files are not touched.
hints.workspace_updated: After the checks pass, you are asked to approve this exact patch; only then is it written into the project folder, and only if the folder has not changed since.

errors.surfaceOff: Router + Fusion is off for agents and workflows, so this runs as Auto. Turn it on in Settings → AI connections → Routing.
errors.modeDormant: This action is not available in this release.
errors.workspaceRequired: Delegate edits files, so it needs a project with a folder to work in.
